note: BH-9035: the review-prs-tmp-capped event is sent only after this many consecutive review-prs ticks on the box were capped by /tmp (any project on the box counts). A tick that measures free /tmp at or above the threshold resets the count. 1 = report on the first capped tick (the BH-6130 behaviour). The count is state/review-prs-tmp-capped.streak. Settings row lane.review-prs.review_tmp_capped_min_ticks.
